A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work with complete, readable main text and Appendices A-G. Their equations, tables, figures, and references support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of SpatialMind prompting and ScanForgeQA fine-tuning, including benchmark results, ablations, and qualitative cases in Section 5 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark experiments, ablations, and case studies reported in Section 5 and Appendix B, including Tables 1-3 and 5.

M1.justification: SpatialMind's scene and question decomposition, coordinate mapping, and inference procedure are unchanged. The ScanForgeQA construction and fine-tuning approach also remains identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training data and evaluate on VSI-Bench, OpenEQA, ScanQA, SQA3D, MVBench, and Video-MME. ScanForgeQA coverage and ShareGPT4Video mixing are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1-3 and 5 retain identical comparator memberships and variants. The additional VLM comparisons in Appendix B, including Gemini-2.0 Flash and LLaVA-NeXT-Video, already appear in v1.

E3.justification: The benchmark subsets, evaluation metrics, model sizes, frame sampling, resolution sweeps, and mixed-data settings remain identical in Section 5 and Appendix A.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the same representation and prompting ablations, fine-tuning dataset comparisons, frame/resolution sensitivity analysis, general-task trade-off experiments, and qualitative cases (Table 3; Figures 3-7).

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The point-estimate reporting practice is unchanged.

E6.justification: Reported scores, plotted trends, and qualitative outcomes match throughout. For example, Tables 1 and 5 retain VSI-Bench +Both averages of 43.9 for Qwen2.5-VL-7B and 47.1 for Qwen2.5-VL-72B.

T1.justification: Equations (1)-(5), covering spatial representations, accumulated transformations, and grid mapping, are unchanged. Section 4.3 retains the same geometric definitions for generating answers.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims: structured prompting and synthetic training data improve visual-spatial reasoning without architectural changes and provide complementary benefits.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and general-task trade-offs are identical. Appendix E retains the same limitations concerning textual spatial representations and single-room scope, while Appendix F preserves the bias and evaluation caveats.

D1.justification: The model defaults, eight NVIDIA H20 GPUs, scan-generation details, prompts, and supplementary-script references remain unchanged. The repository address and resource-access statements are also identical.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix G, and all 86 references are unchanged. Neither the cited literature nor the positioning relative to earlier approaches is revised.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 4 June 2025 to v2 dated 19 September 2025. The title, authors, body wording, section organization, and appendices are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1-10 and Tables 1-6 retain the same graphics, captions, labels, structure, and placement. The document layout is preserved.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, experimental evidence, reproducibility information, limitations, and substantive presentation are unchanged across the main text and appendices. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp does not meaningfully improve or diminish the paper's quality.
